title: Area of Plane Shapes and Circles
seo_title: Area of Plane Shapes – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the area of triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums and circles; find the circumference of circles; solve problems. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on area: triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums, circumference and area of circles, and composite shapes. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height; parallelogram = base × height; trapezium = ½(a + b)h.
  • Circumference = πd = 2πr. Area of a circle = πr².
  • Use π = 22/7 when the radius is a multiple of 7, otherwise use 3.14 or the π button.

Examples

Example

Circle with diameter 14 cm

r = 7

A = 22/7 × 7 × 7

Answer: 154 cm²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using the diameter in πr²Halve it first.
Using the slant heightUse the perpendicular height.
Squaring πOnly the radius is squared.
